source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice mcqs written from Chapter 17 (PDF 85-117), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 17 (Alternating Current) ke poore chapter se practice MCQs hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein. Har sawal ka aik sahi jawab hai aur saath mukhtasar wajah; numerical sawalon mein hal ke qadam diye gaye hain.

blocks.prompt:
1 An alternating current is a current that:
(Alternating current kaisi current hai?)

options.text: aik hi rukh mein yaksaan qeemat se behti hai
aik hi rukh mein jhatkon (pulses) mein behti hai
waqt ke saath barhti hi chali jati hai
waqt ke saath sinusoidally badalti hai

blocks.explanation: AC aisi current hai jo sine ki tarah (sinusoidally) waqt ke saath badalti hai (17.1).

book_ref.quote: An alternating current AC means a sinusoidally varying current

blocks.prompt:
2 In the equation V = Vₒ sin ωt, the symbol ω represents the:
(Masawat V = Vₒ sin ωt mein ω kis cheez ko zahir karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Vₒ zyada se zyada voltage hai aur ω alternating voltage ki angular frequency (zaaviyai frequency) hai (17.1).

book_ref.quote: Vₒ represents maximum value of voltage and ω is the angular frequency

blocks.prompt:
3 In an alternating current, the direction of current reverses after every:
(Alternating current mein current ka rukh har kitne waqt baad ulat jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Current ka rukh har half-cycle (aadhe chakkar) ke baad ulat jata hai (17.1).

book_ref.quote: the direction of current reverses after every half-cycle

blocks.prompt:
4 An alternating voltage changes most rapidly:
(Alternating voltage sab se tezi se kahan badalta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Tabdeeli zero (crossover) points par sab se tez aur peak par sab se aahista hoti hai (17.1).

book_ref.quote: changes occur most rapidly at the zero (crossover) points and most slowly at its peak

blocks.prompt:
5 One complete set of positive and negative values of an alternating quantity is called:
(Alternating quantity ki positive aur negative qeematon ka aik mukammal set kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Positive aur negative qeematon ka aik mukammal set cycle (chakkar) kehlata hai (17.1).

book_ref.quote: One complete set of positive and negative values of an alternating quantity is called a cycle.

blocks.prompt:
6 The path traced by an alternating quantity plotted against time is called its:
(Waqt ke muqable mein plot ki gayi alternating quantity ka raasta kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Waveform woh raasta hai jo alternating quantity waqt ke saath plot karne par banati hai (17.1).

book_ref.quote: The path traced by an alternating quantity

blocks.prompt:
7 An alternating voltage completes one cycle in 0.025 s. Its frequency is:
(Aik alternating voltage 0.025 s mein aik cycle poora karta hai. Is ki frequency kya hai?)

book_ref.quote: The unit of frequency is hertz (Hz); where 1 Hz = 1 cycle per second

blocks.prompt:
8 AC is preferred over DC for supply between cities because AC:
(Shehron ke darmiyan supply ke liye AC ko DC par kyun tarjeeh di jati hai?)

options.text: kam energy zaya kiye lambe faaslon tak bheji ja sakti hai
batteries mein aasani se store hoti hai

blocks.explanation: Box ke mutabiq AC lambe faaslon tak kam energy zaya kiye bhej di jati hai, jab ke DC mein power zaya hoti hai (17.1).

book_ref.quote: AC is easy to be transferred over longer distances

blocks.prompt:
9 The average value of a sinusoidal alternating voltage over one complete cycle is:
(Aik mukammal cycle par sinusoidal alternating voltage ki average qeemat kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Poore cycle par positive aur negative half-cycles aik doosre ko khatam kar dete hain, is liye average zero hai (17.1).

book_ref.quote: If we calculate the average of a complete sine wave over a full cycle (0 to 2π), the result is zero

blocks.prompt:
10 The average value of an AC waveform is usually taken over:
(AC waveform ki average qeemat aam tor par kis hisse par li jati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Poore cycle ka average zero hota hai, is liye average qeemat se murad aadhe cycle (0 se π) ka average hai (17.1).

book_ref.quote: we usually mean the average over one half-cycle (0 to π)

blocks.prompt:
11 The peak value of a full-wave rectified sine voltage is 200 V. Its average value is:
(Full-wave rectified sine voltage ki peak qeemat 200 V hai. Is ki average qeemat kya hai?)

book_ref.quote: For a full-wave rectified sine wave, the average values of current and voltage are given by

blocks.prompt:
12 The average value of an AC waveform is mainly used in situations involving:
(AC waveform ki average qeemat zyada tar kin halaat mein istemal hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Average qeemat rectification mein kaam aati hai jahan output pulsating DC hota hai (17.1).

book_ref.quote: The average value is used in situations involving rectification.

blocks.prompt:
13 The highest value that an AC waveform reaches during one cycle is its:
(Aik cycle mein AC waveform ki sab se oonchi qeemat kya kehlati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Peak ya maximum qeemat aik cycle mein sab se oonchi qeemat hai, Vₒ ya Iₒ likhi jati hai (17.1).

book_ref.quote: It is the highest value that an AC waveform reaches during one cycle.

blocks.prompt:
14 A sinusoidal voltage has a peak value of 170 V. Its peak-to-peak value is:
(Aik sinusoidal voltage ki peak qeemat 170 V hai. Is ki peak-to-peak qeemat kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Symmetrical sine wave ke liye Vp-p = 2Vₒ = 2 × 170 V = 340 V (17.1).

book_ref.quote: This is the total distance from the positive peak to the negative peak of the waveform.

blocks.prompt:
15 An alternating voltage is V = 100 sin ωt volt. Its instantaneous value when ωt = 30° is:
(Alternating voltage V = 100 sin ωt volt hai. Jab ωt = 30° ho to is ki lamhati qeemat kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: V = Vₒ sin ωt = 100 V × sin 30° = 50 V (17.1).

book_ref.quote: The value of an AC quantity at any instant of time is known as instantaneous value.

blocks.prompt:
16 A non-contact voltage detector (pen tester) detects AC under a carpet by sensing the:
(Non-contact voltage detector (pen tester) carpet ke neeche AC ko kis cheez se pehchanta hai?)

options.text: carpet mein paida hone wali hararat
current se banne wala electromagnetic field

blocks.explanation: Non-contact detector current se bannay wale electromagnetic field ko mehsoos karke roshni ya awaz se batata hai (17.1).

book_ref.quote: we can use a non-contact voltage detector, known as a pen tester

blocks.prompt:
17 The rms value of an alternating current is the value of a constant current that produces in a resistor the same:
(Alternating current ki rms qeemat woh constant current hai jo resistor mein wahi ... paida kare:)
blocks.explanation: rms current woh constant current hai jo resistor mein AC jitni hi power (hararat) paida kare (17.1).

book_ref.quote: The value of a constant current that produces the same power in a resistor as the alternating current.

blocks.prompt:
18 The peak value of the mains voltage is 311 V. Its rms value is about:
(Mains voltage ki peak qeemat 311 V hai. Is ki rms qeemat taqreeban kitni hai?)
blocks.explanation: Vrms = 0.707 Vₒ = 0.707 × 311 V ≈ 220 V (17.1). 198 V 0.637 Vₒ yani average hai.

book_ref.quote: So, rms current, Iᵣₘₛ is equal to 0.707 Iₒ

blocks.prompt:
19 An AC ammeter reads an rms current of 5 A. The peak current is:
(AC ammeter rms current 5 A dikhata hai. Peak current kitni hai?)

book_ref.quote: The value of a constant voltage that produces the same power in a resistor as the alternating voltage.

blocks.prompt:
20 The hissing sound near high voltage power lines is mainly caused by:
(High voltage power lines ke paas hissing ki awaz zyada tar kis wajah se hoti hai?)

options.text: corona discharge (ird gird hawa ki ionisation)

blocks.explanation: Corona discharge: taaqatwar electric field conductor ke gird hawa ko ionise (barqi zarraat mein tabdeel) kar deta hai, jis se hissing hoti hai (17.1).

book_ref.quote: The hissing sound often heard near high voltage power lines is primarily caused by corona discharge

blocks.prompt:
21 A current is identified as alternating if it:
(Kisi current ko alternating kab kaha jata hai?)

options.text: aik hi rukh mein behti hai
waqfe waqfe se apna rukh badalti hai

blocks.explanation: Agar current waqfe waqfe se apna rukh badle to AC hai; aik hi rukh mein bahe to DC (17.1).

book_ref.quote: If the current periodically reverses direction, it is alternating current.

blocks.text: 17.2 Relation Between Mean Power and Maximum Power for an Alternating Current

blocks.prompt:
22 A resistive load is one that:
(Resistive load kise kehte hain?)

options.text: magnetic field mein energy store karta hai
energy store nahi karta, hararat ki shakal mein kharch karta hai
electric field mein energy store karta hai
saari energy source ko wapas kar deta hai

blocks.explanation: Resistive load capacitor ya inductor ki tarah energy store nahi karta; sirf hararat ki shakal mein kharch karta hai (17.2).

book_ref.quote: A resistive load is one that does not store energy

blocks.prompt:
23 The instantaneous power in an AC circuit is given by:
(AC circuit mein lamhati (instantaneous) power kis se di jati hai?)

options.text: P = VI, V aur I lamhati qeematein

blocks.explanation: Lamhati power P = VI, jahan V aur I lamhati voltage aur current hain (17.2).

book_ref.quote: The instantaneous power P in a circuit is the power at any given moment in time t.

blocks.prompt:
24 The peak power in a resistor carrying sinusoidal AC is 1200 W. The mean power is:
(Sinusoidal AC wale resistor mein peak power 1200 W hai. Mean power kitni hai?)

book_ref.quote: the mean power Pₘₑₐₙ is the average power over one complete cycle of the AC waveform

blocks.prompt:
25 The maximum power in a resistor R carrying an alternating current of peak value Iₒ is:
(Peak qeemat Iₒ wali alternating current wale resistor R mein maximum power kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Pₘₐₓ = Iₒ²R (Eq. 17.6) (17.2).

book_ref.quote: then the maximum or peak power Pₘₐₓ is given by

blocks.prompt:
26 An rms current of 2 A flows through a 25 Ω resistor. The mean power is:
(25 Ω resistor mein 2 A rms current behti hai. Mean power kitni hai?)
blocks.explanation: Pₘₑₐₙ = Iᵣₘₛ²R = (2 A)² × 25 Ω = 100 W (17.2).

book_ref.quote: Also we have expression for the mean power Pₘₑₐₙ represented by

blocks.prompt:
27 The mean power in a resistive load is only half the peak power because the instantaneous power:
(Resistive load mein mean power peak power ka sirf aadha kyun hai?)

options.text: aadhe cycle mein negative hoti hai
hamesha peak par yaksaan rehti hai
sirf kuch points par maximum hoti hai aur kaafi waqt zero ya kam par rehti hai
load ki inductance par munhasir hai

blocks.explanation: Lamhati power sirf kuch lamhon par maximum hoti hai aur kaafi waqt zero ya kam qeematon par rehti hai, is liye average peak ka aadha hai (17.2).

book_ref.quote: it spends significant time at zero or lower values

blocks.prompt:
28 A peak voltage of 100 V is applied across a 20 Ω resistor. The mean power is:
(20 Ω resistor par 100 V peak voltage lagaya gaya hai. Mean power kitni hai?)

book_ref.quote: As the mean power is half of the maximum (peak) power

blocks.prompt:
29 The angle θ which specifies the instantaneous value of an alternating voltage or current is called its:
(Woh angle θ jo alternating voltage ya current ki lamhati qeemat batata hai, kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Jo angle alternating quantity ki qeemat batata hai use phase kehte hain (17.3).

book_ref.quote: The angle which gives the value of alternating quantity is known as phase.

blocks.prompt:
30 On one AC cycle, the point at which the phase is 3π/2 is where the voltage is:
(AC ke aik cycle par jis point par phase 3π/2 hai, wahan voltage kaisa hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: A se E tak phases 0, π/2, π, 3π/2, 2π hain; 3π/2 par sin θ = −1, yani voltage negative peak par hai (17.3).

book_ref.quote: The phase of points A, B, C, D and E are 0, π/2, π, 3π/2 and 2π respectively

blocks.prompt:
31 The value of the phase angle at t = 0 is called the:
(t = 0 par phase angle ki qeemat kya kehlati hai?)
blocks.explanation: t = 0 par phase angle ko initial phase (ibtidai phase) kehte hain (17.3).

book_ref.quote: the value of the phase angle θ at t equals to zero is called the initial phase

blocks.prompt:
32 If V = Vₒ sin θ and I = Iₒ sin (θ + φ), then:
(Agar V = Vₒ sin θ aur I = Iₒ sin (θ + φ) ho to:)

options.text: current voltage se φ aage (lead) hai
current voltage se φ peeche (lag) hai
voltage current se φ aage hai

blocks.explanation: t = 0 par V = 0 magar I = Iₒ sin φ positive hai; current pehle zero se guzri, is liye φ se aage (lead) hai (17.3).

book_ref.quote: the current is leading the voltage by an angle φ in this situation

blocks.prompt:
33 V = Vₒ sin θ and I = Iₒ sin (θ − φ). At t = 0 (θ = 0), the current is:
(V = Vₒ sin θ aur I = Iₒ sin (θ − φ). t = 0 (θ = 0) par current kitni hai?)
blocks.explanation: I = Iₒ sin (θ − φ) mein θ = 0 rakhne se I = −Iₒ sin φ; current voltage se φ peeche hai (17.3).

book_ref.quote: current I is lagging behind the voltage V by an angle φ

blocks.prompt:
34 A current is I = 4 sin (θ + 30°) A while the voltage is V = 50 sin θ V. The current at θ = 0 is:
(Current I = 4 sin (θ + 30°) A aur voltage V = 50 sin θ V hai. θ = 0 par current kitni hai?)
blocks.explanation: I = 4 sin 30° = 4 × 0.5 = 2 A; current voltage se 30° aage hai (17.3).

book_ref.quote: The angle φ is the phase difference between the voltage and the current.

blocks.prompt:
35 An alternating quantity can be represented by a vector that rotates:
(Alternating quantity ko kaise ghoomne wale vector se zahir kiya jata hai?)

options.text: clockwise, kisi bhi angular frequency se
anticlockwise, quantity ki angular frequency se

blocks.explanation: Yeh vector anticlockwise (ghadi ki sooiyon ke ulat) usi angular frequency se ghoomta hai jo quantity ki hai (17.3).

book_ref.quote: An alternating quantity can be represented by an anticlockwise rotating vector

blocks.prompt:
36 The length of the rotating vector representing an alternating quantity shows its:
(Alternating quantity ko zahir karne wale ghoomte vector ki lambai kya batati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Scale par is ki lambai quantity ki peak ya rms qeemat batati hai (17.3).

book_ref.quote: Its length on a certain scale represents the peak value or rms value

blocks.prompt:
37 The rotating vector of an alternating quantity is horizontal at the instant when the quantity is:
(Alternating quantity ka ghoomta vector us lamhe horizontal hota hai jab quantity:)

options.text: zero ho aur positive taraf barh rahi ho
zero ho aur ghat rahi ho

blocks.explanation: Jab quantity zero ho aur positive taraf barh rahi ho, vector horizontal hota hai (17.3).

book_ref.quote: It is in horizontal position at the instant.

blocks.prompt:
38 The basic circuit elements in an AC circuit are:
(AC circuit ke bunyadi circuit elements kaun se hain?)
blocks.explanation: DC circuit ka bunyadi element resistor hai; AC circuits mein R, L aur C hain (17.4).

book_ref.quote: The basic circuit element in a DC circuit is a resistor R

blocks.prompt:
39 In a DC circuit, the relation between current and voltage across a resistor is given by:
(DC circuit mein resistor par current aur voltage ka taaluq kis se diya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: DC circuit ka resistor Ohm's law V = IR ki pairwi karta hai (17.4).

book_ref.quote: the relation between them is given by Ohm's law (V = IR)

blocks.prompt:
40 In a purely resistive AC circuit, the voltage and current are:
(Khaalis resistive AC circuit mein voltage aur current:)
blocks.explanation: Dono aik hi waqt par maximum aur minimum se guzarte hain, is liye in phase hain (17.5).

book_ref.quote: their instantaneous values are said to be in phase with each other

blocks.prompt:
41 A peak voltage of 240 V is applied across a 60 Ω resistor. The peak current is:
(60 Ω resistor par 240 V peak voltage lagaya gaya. Peak current kitni hai?)

book_ref.quote: where Iₒ = Vₒ/R is the peak or maximum value of current.

blocks.prompt:
42 In the vector diagram for a resistor in an AC circuit, the vectors of V and I are drawn:
(AC circuit mein resistor ke vector diagram mein V aur I ke vectors kaise banaye jaate hain?)
blocks.explanation: V aur I parallel banaye jaate hain kyunke un mein koi phase difference nahi (17.5).

book_ref.quote: V and I are drawn parallel because there is no phase difference between them.

blocks.prompt:
43 An AC of peak value Iₒ produces less heating in a resistor than a DC of value Iₒ because the AC:
(Peak qeemat Iₒ wali AC resistor mein Iₒ wali DC se kam hararat kyun paida karti hai?)

options.text: aadha waqt negative sign rakhti hai
resistor mein sirf aik rukh mein behti hai
har half-cycle mein sirf aik lamhe ke liye maximum par hoti hai

blocks.explanation: Hararat I² par munhasir hai, sign par nahi; magar AC har half-cycle mein sirf aik lamhe ke liye Iₒ par hoti hai (17.5).

book_ref.quote: the alternating current is at this maximum value only for an instant during each half-cycle

blocks.prompt:
44 A 2 kW heater works on a 220 V supply. The current it takes is:
(2 kW heater 220 V supply par chalta hai. Yeh kitni current leta hai?)

book_ref.quote: It is to be noted that here P is measured in watts V in volts, I in amperes and R in ohms

blocks.prompt:
45 The relation P = VI for power holds good only when:
(Power ka taaluq P = VI sirf kab durust hai?)

options.text: V aur I in phase hon

blocks.explanation: Eq. 17.12 sirf tab durust hai jab V aur I in phase hon (17.5).

book_ref.quote: the Eq.(17.12) for power holds good only when V and I are in phase

blocks.prompt:
46 A doorbell is often run on 12 V AC because low-voltage AC:
(Doorbell aksar 12 V AC par kyun chalayi jati hai?)

options.text: mehfooz hai aur shock ka khatra kam karti hai
bell ise DC mein badal deti hai

blocks.explanation: Kam voltage wali AC sambhalne mein mehfooz hai aur shock ka khatra kam karti hai (17.5).

book_ref.quote: Low-voltage AC is safer to handle and reduces the risk of electrical shock.

blocks.prompt:
47 A heating element takes 5 A rms from a 230 V rms supply. Its average power is:
(Heating element 230 V rms supply se 5 A rms leta hai. Is ki average power kitni hai?)

book_ref.quote: The opposition to AC which the circuit presents is the resistance given by

blocks.prompt:
48 An inductor (choke) is a component having:
(Inductor (choke) kaisa component hai?)

options.text: bari resistance aur koi inductance nahi
bari self-inductance aur na hone ke barabar resistance

blocks.explanation: Inductor do terminal wala passive component hai jis ki self-inductance bari aur resistance na hone ke barabar hai (17.6).

book_ref.quote: a passive two terminal electrical component having a large value of self -inductance and negligible resistance

blocks.prompt:
49 An inductor slows down current surges by temporarily storing energy in:
(Inductor current ke achanak ubhaar (surges) ko kis mein energy store karke dheema karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Inductor electromagnetic field mein energy store karke aur phir wapas de kar surges ko dheema karta hai (17.6).

book_ref.quote: The inductor is used to slow down current surges or spikes

blocks.prompt:
50 In a purely inductive AC circuit, the current:
(Khaalis inductive AC circuit mein current:)

options.text: voltage ke saath in phase hai

blocks.explanation: V = Vₒ sin (ωt + π/2) se, current voltage se 90° (π/2 rad) peeche hai (17.6).

book_ref.quote: The current in an inductor always lags behind the voltage by 90° or π/2 rad.

blocks.prompt:
51 A coil of inductance 0.2 H is connected to a 50 Hz supply. Its inductive reactance is about:
(0.2 H inductance wali coil 50 Hz supply se jodi gayi. Is ki inductive reactance taqreeban kitni hai?)

book_ref.quote: inductive reactance X_L is directly proportional to both, frequency of current and the inductance L

blocks.prompt:
52 If the frequency of the supply to a pure inductor is doubled, its inductive reactance:
(Khaalis inductor ki supply ki frequency dugni kar di jaye to us ki inductive reactance:)
blocks.explanation: X_L = 2πfL, f ke seedha mutanasib hai; f dugna to X_L dugna (17.6).

book_ref.quote: In case of DC, f = 0, so X_L = 0, while in case of large AC frequency, X_L is also large.

blocks.prompt:
53 An ideal inductor:
(Aik ideal inductor:)

options.text: DC guzarta hai magar AC ko rokta hai
DC rokta hai magar AC guzarta hai
DC aur AC dono rokta hai
DC ke liye la-mehdood reactance rakhta hai

blocks.explanation: DC ke liye f = 0 to X_L = 0, aur zyada frequency par X_L bari; inductor DC guzarta aur AC rokta hai (17.6).

book_ref.quote: Thus, we conclude that an inductor allows DC but blocks the AC.

blocks.prompt:
54 The SI unit of inductive reactance is:
(Inductive reactance ki SI unit kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: X_L ki unit ohm hai (17.6).

book_ref.quote: allows DC but blocks the AC. The unit of X_L is ohm.

blocks.prompt:
55 The average power dissipated in a pure inductor over one cycle is:
(Aik cycle mein khaalis inductor mein average power kitni kharch hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Khaalis inductor magnetic field mein energy store karke wapas kar deta hai; aik cycle ki average power zero hai (17.6).

book_ref.quote: The average power dissipated in a pure inductor is zero.

blocks.prompt:
56 Since an inductor does not consume energy, it is used for:
(Kyunke inductor energy kharch nahi karta, is liye yeh kis kaam aata hai?)

options.text: AC ko DC mein badalne ke liye
plates par charge store karne ke liye
energy kharch kiye baghair AC control karne ke liye

blocks.explanation: Inductor energy kharch nahi karta, is liye AC ko energy zaya kiye baghair control karne ke kaam aata hai (17.6).

book_ref.quote: it is used for controlling AC without consuming energy

blocks.prompt:
57 A 0.25 H coil of negligible resistance carries an rms current of 20 mA at 500 Hz. The rms voltage across it is about:
(Na hone ke barabar resistance wali 0.25 H coil mein 500 Hz par 20 mA rms current hai. Is par rms voltage taqreeban kitna hai?)

book_ref.quote: A 400 mH coil of negligible resistance is connected to an AC circuit

blocks.prompt:
58 A choke is a coil of thick copper wire wound in a large number of turns over a:
(Choke moti copper wire ki coil hai jo bohat se turns mein kis par lapeti jati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Choke moti copper wire ke bohat se turns ki coil hai jo soft iron laminated core par lapeti jati hai (17.7).

book_ref.quote: It is a coil of thick copper wire wound closely in a large number of turns over a soft iron laminated core.

blocks.prompt:
59 Because the resistance of a choke coil is negligibly small, its power factor is:
(Kyunke choke coil ki resistance bohat kam hai, is ka power factor kitna hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: R bohat kam hone se choke ka cos θ taqreeban zero aur θ taqreeban 90° hota hai (17.7).

book_ref.quote: the power factor (cosθ) of the choke coil is almost zero

blocks.prompt:
60 The phase difference between current and voltage in a choke coil is nearly:
(Choke coil mein current aur voltage ke darmiyan phase difference taqreeban kitna hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Choke mein θ taqreeban 90° hai, is liye amalan hararat ki shakal mein power zaya nahi hoti (17.7).

book_ref.quote: So practically, no power is dissipated as heat by a choke coil.

blocks.prompt:
61 The inductance of a choke coil is very high because of the:
(Choke coil ki inductance bohat zyada kyun hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Iron core ki zyada permeability (magnetic guzargahi) ki wajah se choke ki L bohat zyada hoti hai (17.7).

book_ref.quote: The inductance L of the choke coil is also very high due to the high permeability of iron core

blocks.prompt:
62 A choke is used to:
(Choke kis maqsad ke liye istemal hota hai?)

options.text: zyada frequency AC rokna, DC aur kam frequency AC guzarna
DC rokna aur zyada frequency AC guzarna
smoothing ke liye charge store karna

blocks.explanation: Choke zyada frequency wali AC ko rokta hai aur DC aur kam frequency wali AC ko guzarne deta hai (17.7).

book_ref.quote: Also choke is used to block high frequency AC while allowing DC and low frequency AC to pass.

blocks.prompt:
63 In a fluorescent light, the choke:
(Fluorescent light mein choke kya karta hai?)

options.text: tube ke liye AC ko DC banata hai
tube jalane ke liye charge store karta hai
tube se saari current hata deta hai
transient voltages paida karta hai jo gas ke breakdown mein madad dete hain

blocks.explanation: Fluorescent light mein choke tube par lamhati (transient) voltages paida karta hai jo gas ke breakdown mein madad dete hain (17.7).

book_ref.quote: Chokes in fluorescent lights generate transient voltages across the tube

blocks.prompt:
64 In switch-mode power supplies, choke coils help to:
(Switch-mode power supplies mein choke coils kis kaam aati hain?)

options.text: voltage regulate karna aur switching noise saaf karna
electric field mein energy store karna

blocks.explanation: Switch-mode power supplies mein choke voltage ko regulate karne aur switching noise saaf karne ke liye zaroori hai (17.7).

book_ref.quote: They are essential in switch-mode power supplies

blocks.prompt:
65 A capacitor does not allow DC to pass because:
(Capacitor DC ko kyun nahi guzarne deta?)

options.text: DC ke liye reactance zero hai
plates ke darmiyan insulating medium hai
magnetic field mein energy store karta hai
